name: trustpilot-reviews-scraper
title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper: Ratings & Replies
description: $0.04 per company check + $1/1,000 saved reviews. Public Trustpilot reviews, ratings, replies, reply timing and company summaries. No Trustpilot API key required.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

review-scraped.eventDescription: Charged for each Trustpilot review successfully extracted and saved to the dataset.

company-check.eventDescription: $0.04 once per unique company per run, before its page is requested. Covers the company check including empty, filtered or blocked attempts. Duplicate inputs and same-run retries do not add another fee.
